summary: lineinfile options: group, and insertafter or insertbefore a regex (last match by default, EOF/BOF special values), which only apply when regexp doesn't match.
questions: How do I add a line right after a matching line?
How do I add a line at the very beginning of a file?
Why is insertafter ignored when my regexp matches?
Can I use insertafter and insertbefore together?

answer_card.title: lineinfile insertafter / insertbefore
answer_card.answer_md:
- `insertafter`: regex (last match) or `EOF` (default). No match → EOF
- `insertbefore`: regex or `BOF`; no match → end of file
- Only honored if `regexp` finds no match. Can't combine with each other or with `backrefs`. Use `firstmatch` for the first match.
- `group`: owner group
